title: AarogyaSeva — Rural Healthcare Intelligence Mesh
summary: AarogyaSeva is an offline-first clinical decision-support platform for community health workers in rural India, combining on-device ML inference, explainability, and P2P federated learning across nine clinical 'pillars'. Its Pillar 9 synthetic-data module trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on seed patient data and evaluates it with SDMetrics' QualityReport to produce and validate synthetic training data.
